text:
morgan: quick question — I need to grant a contractor read access to logs for a single project while we debug a pipeline. Do we prefer a predefined role or a short-lived custom role?

tess: short answer: short-lived predefined if possible. which logs bucket / project?

morgan: project: analytics-prod, logs in Cloud Logging (not a GCS bucket). They only need to tail/inspect logs for a week.

tess: then use the builtin role `roles/logging.viewer` scoped to the project. No org-level binding. Short-lived via JIT ticket + timebound IAM binding.

morgan: ok — does `roles/logging.viewer` include access to view metadata that might have PII? worried about anything that shows raw payloads in logs.

alex: it can surface whatever we logged. Redaction is responsibility of the service. If logs contain raw PII we must redact before granting external access. For contractors, prefer masking + sanitized views. Example: redact via logging exclusion or use log sinks to sanitized bucket and grant access there.

morgan: good point. We do have a sink `projects/analytics-prod/sinks/sanitized-logs` that strips request bodies. Might just grant read there instead.

tess: granting on a sink/bucket is safest. If you must grant `roles/logging.viewer` at project level, add a conditional binding for `request.time` <= timestamp for expiry and log the grant in JIT.

morgan: how do we add a timebound binding? can I do it with gcloud?

tess: yes — example: ```gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding analytics-prod --member="user:contractor@example.com" --role="roles/logging.viewer" --condition="title=limited;expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-02T00:00:00Z');description=one-week access"```

alex: also file a JIT ticket and note the sink/bucket or project binding. Security will review the logs sample.

morgan: noted. one more: if I grant access to sanitized sink (GCS), do I need `roles/storage.objectViewer`?

tess: yeah `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the sink bucket and `roles/logging.viewer` is not needed then. Prefer that path.

sec-bot: Reminder: create a JIT request and attach the sanitized sample. Template: https://rwd.infra/jit-template

morgan: thanks all — i'll open a JIT, grant `storage.objectViewer` on the sanitized sink for one week using a conditional, and ping here when done. :thumbsup:
